page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines from top to bottom: the author's name and title in large capitals and roman type, then "PRO VETERI MEDICINA" in spaced capitals, an ornament, and the imprint at the foot. A handwritten mark at top right is not printed and is left out.
page.notes: The ornament between "MEDICINA." and the imprint is a printer's flower and carries no text. The first line begins with a partly cut-off letter, read as F. The date is printed in the old reversed-C form and is given as printed in the imprint line: MDCLXX. The "s" in the author's name is printed as S. A handwritten "1." at top right is not printed text and is left out.
